documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart
Hand-written wrappers, loaders, and helpers in sportsdataverse.basketball.dbl that are not generated API-endpoint wrappers (those have their own reference pages).

sportality_player_crosswalk(season: 'int', game_type: 'str' = 'regular', *, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False) -> 'Frame' Genius person id -> athlete uuid for every player of a Basketligaen season, from one stats-info call. The site has two player id systems: the Genius person id that play-by-play, box scores and stats tables key on (and that joins the genius family), and the platform athlete uuid that rosters and athlete routes key on. The players_summary table's players{} map is keyed by Genius id and carries each player's uuid. Parameters Returns polars.DataFrame | pandas.DataFrame: one row per player: player_id (Genius, Int64), athlete_uuid (null where the site has none, common before about 2005), names, nationality, gender, position, jersey number, height and weight. Birth dates are dropped. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.dbl import sportality_player_crosswalk xw = sportality_player_crosswalk(2026) xw.filter(xw["player_id"] == 1887576)

sportality_ssgt_uuid(season: 'int', game_type: 'str' = 'regular') -> 'str' The Basketligaen ssgt uuid of a season (END year) and game type, from /statistics-v2/layout-info. Use it for the routes that take an ssgt uuid directly (sportality_standings, sportality_sites, sportality_ssgt_provider, sportality_post_game_team_stats, sportality_player_h2h). The directory is fetched once per process. Parameters Returns the ssgt uuid (e.g. "qzw34da6jg" for the 2025/26 regular season). Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.dbl import sportality_ssgt_uuid sportality_ssgt_uuid(2026) # 2025/26 regular season sportality_ssgt_uuid(2026, "finals") # 2025/26 playoffs

sportsdataverse.basketball.dbl — 25 endpoints. Note: Unofficial: the JSON API behind www.basketligaen.dk, the Danish men's basketball league (Basketligaen, series code DBL). The site runs on the Sportality platform (the vendor behind the SHL and HockeyAllsvenskan wrappers). The terms page was not read; payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Note: Stats provider: genius-basketball, a relay of Genius Sports LiveStats. The Genius match, team and person ids in play-by-play, box scores and stats tables (game_id, team_id, player_id, all Int64) join the genius family; the platform uuids (game, team, athlete, ssgt) are not Genius ids and exist only on this site. The Genius ORG code of Denmark is not exposed. Note: Season = the END year (2026 = 2025/26) everywhere; the runtime maps it, with game_type ('regular' or 'finals', the playoffs), to the site's ssgt (season + series + game type) through layout-info. Schedules, standings and season tables start in 2002/03; game-level data (play-by-play with shot x/y, box scores, team stats) starts in 2023/24. Note: Source defects the runtime refuses (AssetFetchError): an unfinished game or a truncated play-by-play feed, a box score or feed that names another game, a cut stats table. The 2002/03 regular-season schedule lists 109 finished games where its own standings count 110: a source gap. Note: Personal data is removed from every body: birth dates, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, addresses and contact blocks. Note: No women's league: Dameligaen has its own domain (dameligaen.dk), which answers 401 to anonymous requests.
